text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is left blank ('---') while note N3 specifies hardening to 24-32 HRC but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment applies (e.g., before or after final machining). This ambiguity can cause the supplier to apply heat treatment at the wrong stage, leading to distortion of finished features or inability to machine hardened material. The designer should fill in the heat treatment field and update note N3 to specify the process stage.","recommended_correction":"Update the title block 'heat_treatment' field with the required treatment and revise note N3 to explicitly state when the heat treatment is to be performed relative to machining and surface treatment."}]}
